description.value: The Loft Pub is a Victoria institution on Gorge Road East offering live music every day of the week, with a strong emphasis on Rock and Blues featuring both cover acts and original artists. It's a full-service, adult-oriented neighbourhood pub with a large selection of micro-brewed and traditional beers on tap and a pub menu anchored by daily specials and a locally famous Caesar salad. The venue shares a property with The Coachman Eatery, which offers a separate full-service dining room, making it a multi-option stop for a cycling group with varied appetites.
